budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: 3:4 capture transfer split per clock root (ABI ck_cap_x34_t): ot_s81_vm_x34 = x34_s (phase/parity/marker + three 543-bit banks, every output a flop) + x34_t (fixed-edge bank reads, parity/phase assertions); the flow's multiple_cts_roots leaf admits only same-frequency roots, the related 3:4 arcs (>= 1.111 ns launch->capture, bank held 3.333 ns) are parent paths. Same flops/logic; tb_ot_s81_vm_x34 and cap16 production identical. r2 (native audit of r1 views: capture 273.6 ps > 190 on 1458 input pins): r1's square 172.8 um body put the bank/output flops toward three output faces, so inputs crossed ~170 um to their capture flops. r2 is a flow-direction slice 43.2 x 345.6: all inputs W, all outputs E, clock/reset N; input->capture wire <= ~43 um. Same RTL/ports/flops (byte-identical source).
